title: Cold Soba Noodle Salad
description: Chilled buckwheat noodles with edamame, cucumber, carrot and scallions in a sesame, soy and ginger dressing. Great for packed lunches.

image.alt: A bowl of soba noodles with edamame, cucumber, carrot and sesame

ingredients.scaleNote: Use a big pot of water whatever the batch size.

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil. Add the soba and cook as the package says, usually {time 4-5 min}, adding the edamame for the last {time 2 min notimer}.
Drain and rinse under cold running water, rubbing the noodles gently with your hands to wash off the starch, until completely cool. Shake off as much water as you can.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, maple syrup and ginger in a large bowl.
Add the noodles, edamame, cucumber, carrot and most of the green onions and toss until coated. Top with the rest of the green onions and the sesame seeds.

notes: Most soba contains some wheat. For gluten-free, buy 100% buckwheat soba and use tamari.
Keeps for 2 days in the fridge; toss with a splash of water or soy sauce to loosen.
